name: Isometric
tagline: Solid blocks at 30°, lit from the top-left, that press into the page.
description: Isometric UI treats every interactive surface as a physical block seen from a 30° axonometric angle. Depth is built from hard, unblurred extrusions that fall down and to the right, a single light source keeps faces consistent, and pressing an element pushes it flush into the surface. Text stays flat and axis-aligned so it is always readable.

stage.light: repeating-linear-gradient(30deg, var(--iso-grid) 0 1px, transparent 1px 28px), repeating-linear-gradient(150deg, var(--iso-grid) 0 1px, transparent 1px 28px), var(--iso-stage)
stage.dark: repeating-linear-gradient(30deg, var(--iso-grid) 0 1px, transparent 1px 28px), repeating-linear-gradient(150deg, var(--iso-grid) 0 1px, transparent 1px 28px), var(--iso-stage)
